subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Consumer Demand for Green
description: A quick, practical guide to Consumer Demand for Green.

hook.text: 73% of millennials say they'd pay more for sustainable products. Their wallets are backing their values.

buildup.text: Consumer preference for sustainable products is growing across all age groups and income levels.

discovery.text: Brands with verified sustainability credentials command 10–30% price premiums in many categories.

twist.text: The intention-action gap is real. Many consumers say they'll pay more but choose the cheaper option at checkout.

climax.text: Making the green option the default—not the premium—closes the gap and drives mass adoption.

punchline.text: Consumers want green. Make it easy and they'll choose it.

quiz.question: What is the intention-action gap in green consumerism?
options: Consumers say they'll pay more but often choose cheaper options
